install.mobileWarning: Beamlynx is a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Visit this page on your computer to install it.

mac.viaBrew: Via Homebrew (Apple Silicon only for now):

windows.smartScreenWarning: This build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you. Click <1>More info</1> then <3>Run anyway</3> to launch it.

linux.download: Run this in a terminal. It downloads the AppImage and starts it. The AppImage works on most distros and needs no installation. You can also <1>download it yourself</1>.
linux.orDeb: On Debian or Ubuntu, you can instead <1>download the .deb</1> and install the file with <3>sudo apt install ./beamlynx-*.deb</3>. Beamlynx isn't in apt's repositories or the AUR yet.
